HL-3340Clarified Butter Oil, anhydrous, 99.9% milkfat18 drums, 7,920 lb net

We declare that the cream from which the goods described above were manufactured was produced on farms in the states of Washington, Oregon and Idaho and processed at our Tacoma facility, so that the goods are wholly of United States origin within the meaning of 19 CFR Part 134. The steel drums in which the goods are packed are manufactured in Canada; packaging origin does not affect the origin of the contents.

Residue verification for this material is performed under contract by a laboratory in Germany accredited to ISO/IEC 17025; the location of testing likewise has no bearing on origin. The goods are not eligible for export to Japan under the current bilateral arrangement and must not be forwarded to that market.

This declaration is issued in respect of the consignment identified above. It is not a general statement and does not carry an expiry; a separate declaration accompanies each consignment.
